title: pm(dispatch-gates): --commands does not derive the self-test of a script that imports a changed scripts/pm module
body:
domain:skills#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5pjSPT7ui2EUcunaVb

Filing gate: ① (a gate-derivation defect measured on PR #33804, record 6893545108).

On PR #33804's first head (two files: `scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs`, `scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs`), `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 35 gates and did NOT derive `check:pm-fleet-write-execute`, although `scripts/pm/fleet-write/execute.mjs` imports `readWorkflowDiff` from a changed file and its self-test fakes that function's git calls. The developer's "35 of 35 exit 0" coexisted with a red `Lint · repo & tooling gates` on the head (2 of 415 executor cases). Once the PR also touched `execute.mjs`, 42 gates were derived, that one among them.

## What lands
- `--commands` derives the self-test of every script that imports a changed `scripts/pm/**` module (the reverse import edge), at least for the fleet-write executor, validator and dispatcher; a self-test row replays PR #33804's first file list and expects `check:pm-fleet-write-execute` in the output.

`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` and its self-test; `skip-changeset`; `Clause-②: no`. Ungoverned. Grading is triage's.
